tianxia.talent.gravity.local_down.reviewed_by: AUTO67 2026-10-05: the successful save's difficult terrain and the 6-point cost

effects.evidence: Creatures of your choice inside the area make Strength saving throws when the effect appears.

on_fail.evidence: The creature falls in the chosen direction until it strikes a surface, exits the area, or falls 60 feet.

on_success.label: Local Down: while it stands in this area, the ground is difficult terrain, so each step of walking costs double.
on_success.evidence: Successful Save: The creature holds position but treats the area as difficult terrain until the start of its next turn.

tianxia.talent.gravity.gravity_sense.reviewed_by: AUTO67 2026-10-05: the +2 on a check made to resist a Gravity effect runs (combat/ext/gravity.py)
riders: You sense major gravitational distortions within 120 feet.

You know when a creature or object within that range changes weight supernaturally, falls through supernatural force, enters a Gravity Domain, uses levitation or flight, becomes anchored by supernatural weight, or creates a gravity well, local down, orbit or pressure field.

The +2 applies to a Cultivation Check made to get out of a Gravity effect, such as the one to teleport out of an Event Horizon Prison. There is no check on this table for spotting an effect, and on any other Cultivation Check this is a ruling.
